coverage.target: Security design: separate pipeline, deployment, application, and audit roles with resource-scoped IAM.
Security design: preserve KMS/TLS and the contract topology without inbound SQS or ingress DLQ.
Security design: review IAM, encryption, OIDC trust, and resource boundaries in each CDK change.
Security design: OIDC trust restricted to audience, repository, authorized reference, and environment.
Security design: temporary STS sessions only; no persistent AWS credentials in logs, caches, or artifacts.
Security design: separate validation, staging, and production roles; production promotion requires human approval.
Security design NFR8.1: lockfile install, format, ESLint, and TypeScript check block integration on failure.
Security design NFR8.2: unit suite and critical AWS-simulated integration suite block integration on failure.
Security design NFR8.3: dependency and secret scans block on configured findings; exceptions are recorded.
Security design NFR8.4: protected main, review, green checks, squash merge, and gated production promotion.
Security design NFR9.1: versioned TypeScript/CDK, repeatable synthesis, and artifact digest tracking.
Security design NFR9.2: preserve the service artifact and topology established by the contract.
Security design NFR10.1: CloudTrail administrative events and real-account verification checklist.
Security design NFR10.2: KMS-protected log storage with at least 90-day retention.
Security design NFR10.3: audit role separated; application and application-deployment roles cannot alter trail evidence.
Security design NFR10.4: static CDK policy check separated from verification of real CloudTrail events.
